name: Files
description: Your files on all your devices, shared with people you choose.

actions.name: files.list
actions.description: List a folder (the root when path is empty). Shared folders appear under Shared/<person>/.

actions.name: files.read
actions.description: Where a file's content is: its blob hash, and a local path when the folder is kept on this device.

actions.name: files.write
actions.description: Create or replace a file from a blob hash or from text. Pass base (the blob you started from) to detect a concurrent edit.

actions.name: files.move
actions.description: Move or rename a file or folder.

actions.name: files.copy
actions.description: Copy a file or folder (no bytes are copied: the content is shared by hash).

actions.name: files.delete
actions.description: Delete files or folders from all devices.

actions.name: files.search
actions.description: Find files and folders by name.

actions.name: files.share
actions.description: Share a folder with people (by id or petname), read or write.

actions.name: files.unshare
actions.description: Stop sharing a folder with people (everyone when people is empty). Copies they already have stay with them.

actions.name: files.shared
actions.description: Folders shared with me and folders I share.

actions.name: files.keep
actions.description: Keep a folder on this device (true) or make it online only (false).

actions.name: files.conflicts
actions.description: Files where two devices edited the same version.

actions.name: files.resolve
actions.description: Settle a conflict: keep "this" (the version that has the name), "that" (the other one) or "both".

actions.name: files.status
actions.description: Sync state of this device and of my other devices.

actions.name: files.sync
actions.description: Rescan the folder and fetch every device's changes now; returns the sync state.
